gpu_tip: ~17GB total at 128K context. Lower quality than the Q4 rung but usable. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 16GB DDR5 kit covers it via llama.cpp's layer offloading. The ~11GB KV cache doesn't shrink with the weights, so the KV cache knob's q4_0 option saves more than dropping another rung.
mac_tip: Needs ~17GB — fits a 24GB MacBook Pro (M4, M4 Pro, M5, or M5 Pro) comfortably; a 16GB config needs the KV cache knob's q4_0 option.
